threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still get flustered trying to navigate the bus map and miss the fact that the 394 ends at midnight, not the 24-hour routes.
Heard a couple arguing about whether the 333 bus driver took the scenic route. Turns out, the driver’s just a real fan of the backstreets.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy in a tracksuit debating philosophy with a pigeon on Karl-Marx-Straße. Only in Neukölln, right?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find spontaneous street art battles that turn an ordinary day into a canvas. Graffiti artists push creativity to its limits.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local if they can name the taco truck behind the laundromat but still can’t figure out BART delays on a Friday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading commuters with a ukulele on the 38 bus today, while someone else tried to sell him a sandwich. Only in SF...

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Gràcia' is all about the parks and plazas, but they miss the tucked-away bakeries serving the best panellets at dawn.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they stare at the metro map like it’s hieroglyphics, while locals glide through without a second thought.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You start asking for directions to the nearest tube, but forget that the nearest one is a bus ride away. It's all about the Overground here.
Last night on the N137, a bloke was serenading the whole bus with 90s R&B. Never heard so many folks humming along, even the driver cracked a smile.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids setting up a makeshift café in the park, complete with flower decorations and a hand-painted sign. Pure Neukölln spirit.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the U-Bahn stations are basically mini art galleries? It’s like a treasure hunt every time you ride. Keeps the commute interesting!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can always tell a local by how they navigate a BART meltdown—while others panic, we just pull out our phones and grab a taco.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling while waiting for the 19 over by Turk. He lost his balance, dropped a ball, and a pigeon snagged it. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but the real gems are the quiet squares like Plaza del Sol, where locals sip vermut and swap stories.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They stand in front of Gaudí's buildings with their phones out, taking selfies for every angle, while locals just pass by with a smile.
